_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Adding the item to your wardrobe...

description: Adds one item that the signed-in user owns to their Able.Style wardrobe from a text description supplied by the user. Use this when the user describes an item in words and asks to add it. When a photo, attachment or image URL is the source, use add_wardrobe_item_from_image; if transfer is unavailable, use create_image_upload with purpose wardrobe_image_add. Do not infer a description from an image and call this tool unless the user explicitly requests a description-based item instead of uploading the image. For an item already returned by suggest-outfit-tool, use add-to-or-remove-from-wardrobe-by-id with its exact styleIdentifier. IMPORTANT: Before calling, make sure the description contains exactly one apparel, footwear, or wearable-accessory item and explicitly includes its colour. If colour is missing, ask the user for it before calling. An optional menswear or womenswear value overrides the user's profile preference; omit it when the profile preference should be used. The result includes a link for reviewing the added item. A newly created item's image may still be generated in the background.

description.description: A 10–150 character description of exactly one item the user owns. Use the user's text; do not substitute your interpretation of an attached image unless the user explicitly requests a description-based item. It must explicitly include the item's colour; do not invent or infer an omitted colour.

menswearOrWomenswear.description: Optional clothing preference for resolving categories. Supply only when the user has specified menswear or womenswear; otherwise omit it to use their profile.

name: add_wardrobe_item_from_description
title: Add Wardrobe Item from Description
